principles.name: prove-it-works
principles.decision: the VERIFY fence runs the installed binary, not the source tree

title: Install the bird CLI on PATH as a compiled binary
description: bird currently runs only as `bend src/effects.bend -- <args>`, so every caller needs the Bend toolchain and the published release has no command of its own. Scope: compile a native binary with `bend src/effects.bend -o`, install it to ~/.local/bin/bird (already on PATH), document the install command in README and AGENTS.md, and correct the stale `sh` requirement in tests/e2e.sh. Acceptance: the installed `bird` answers `version --json` with 0.3.0 without `bend` on PATH, and the missing-attachment case still exits 2 with retryable false through the binary.
